name: Puck
description: Puck is an Artificial Spirit created by Echidna and the former contracted familiar of Emilia, affectionately serving as a father figure to her. Counted among the Four Great Spirits as the Great Spirit of Fire and the monstrous 'Beast of the End', his playful cat-like demeanor conceals world-freezing cataclysmic power should Emilia ever perish, as demonstrated across devastating loops in Arc 3 and Arc 4.
